title: MCP tool errors rmcp builds for malformed arguments lack the reminders and next other tool errors carry
outcome: MCP tool errors rmcp builds for malformed arguments lack the reminders and next other tool errors carry
acceptance: In ordinary engram mcp, a tool call whose arguments fail deserialization (for example update with an action word that does not exist, or an undeclared field) returns an isError tool result whose structured JSON carries a stable code, error.reminders and error.next like the other tool errors, or docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md states that rmcp's own argument errors have no such fields; a real-stdio test pins the shape.

completion.summary: Documentation branch delivered: in ordinary engram mcp, an argument a word's input schema rejects (undeclared field, wrong type, unknown action) is refused by the MCP library before the word runs as an isError tool error with text-only content describing the problem and no structured JSON, reminders or next; the MCP INSTRUCTIONS sentence, cli-and-mcp.md, shipped.md and the engram-use skill now say so (read-only mode refuses such arguments itself as structured mcp_read_only_refused), and source/test comments speak of every error Engram itself returns. A real-stdio dogfood test pins the shape for all three cases and a following valid call. Field naming for type errors is filed as w-c8e867988b60. Store judgment: none; readiness ready on all 4 stores.
